context: `verify` is the tamper-evidence verdict operators rely on; `_rotate_if_needed` is the only writer that moves evidence files.

claims.text: DEFECT: verify() returns (True, None) for a ledger whose oldest retained segment starts mid-chain, so a pruned prefix is indistinguishable from a complete genesis chain

DEFECT: _rotate_if_needed moves the active file away and deletes segments past `LEDGER_KEEP_ROTATIONS` without persisting any boundary record, so a fresh loader cannot tell pruning from prefix tampering
